story_type: overdue boater alone in the water at night, infrared camera finds him waving, swimmer and hoist
hook: That white shape is a man in the water at night, waving.
narration: That white shape is a man alone in the water at night, waving his arm.
He was an overdue boater, six miles off Three Rooker Island. A Jayhawk from Clearwater found him.
Its infrared camera sees heat, so a warm body glows against the cold black water.
The crew lowered a rescue swimmer under the spotlight. [short pause]
The swimmer reached him and held on, with the helicopter roaring overhead.
Then the cable pulled them up out of the water together.
outcome: The 39 year old reached Tampa General Hospital in stable condition.
title: Man waving in the water, found at night
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew and a Station Sand Key boat crew rescued an overdue boater about six miles west of Three Rooker Island, Florida, in March 2026.
